text:
leo chen: kicking off onboarding for customer Calypso's LoRA (calypso-invoice-v0). target: pegasus-13b baseline, quickpack for invoice tokens + quant sanity on int4. posting results here.

leo chen: command run: `./quickpack --base pegasus-13b --lora calypso-invoice-v0.safetensors --quant int4 --checks invoice_tokens,token_stability,formatting --out /runs/calypso_qp1`

anya grover: include edge set 'invoice_weirdness.json' (cases: '#INV006', 'INV#006', leading zero variants, negative amounts). also add a micro-set for escape-token cases like '\#INV' and plain '#' alone.

sanjay p: FYI customer trained with a custom special token '<INV>' mapped to a single id. if merge aliases to '<'+'INV'+'>', downstream parser breaks. lock that token if we can.

splice-bot: run started id=calypso-qp-1749001234 on p-qe-gpu-08. logs -> /runs/calypso_qp1/log.txt

leo chen: first quickpass finished: 4/9 tests failing. most common: splitting of '<INV>' into three tokens, and decimal drop (.00 -> .0). sample output: `expected: "<INV-0007>" got: "< INV-0007 >"`

anya grover: token split likely from token merge aliasing. check merge log for 'token alias' warnings. also check postproc glue rules for angle brackets.

sanjay p: merge log: `WARN: token_alias: '<INV>' id 53012 collides -> alias to ['<','INV','>']`. propose vocab-lock for '<INV>' to original id 53012 and re-run merge with conservative prune.

leo chen: applying vocab_lock.json {"<INV>":"53012","CUR$":"60299"} and re-run with `--vocab-lock` and quant flags `--rounding bankers --prune conservative`.

ci-bot: CI advisory: please attach token_diff.json and quickpack report to PR.

splice-bot: re-run complete id=calypso-qp-1749001510. smoke results: 8/9 pass. '<INV>' preserved; decimal formatting fixed. remaining: slight ROUGE-L drop (-0.7) on long narrative invoices (>1k tokens). artifacts uploaded s3://redwood-evals/calypso/1749001510/report.html and /runs/calypso_qp1/token_diff.json

anya grover: ROUGE dip expected at int4 for long contexts. recommend short dedicated canary with mixed-KV int8 to compare quality vs latency. also add a pre-merge CI gate that fails if any token from customer_protected_tokens.txt is mapped to a multi-token sequence.

sanjay p: +1. I'll draft a tiny unit test and PR to enforce token-stability. also will add a note to onboarding checklist about preserving bracketed special tokens.

leo chen: will notify CS and schedule a canary next week. marking quickpack resolved and saving artifacts. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
